d: 'Aigiri Nandini Nanditha Medhini' is a very popular Durga Devi Stotram. Aigiri Nandini is Mahishasura Mardini Stotra to Kill the darkness and get victory over tough times in life. Mahishasura Mardini is the Stotra of Maa Durga Narrated in Maa Durga Chandi path in Durga Sapatashati. This Stotra is named Mahishasura Mardini as Maa Durga has defeated demon Mahishasura while taking chandi form. Aigiri Nandini is basically the most powerful Mahishasura Mardini Stotra to get rid of difficulties of life.
